findings.title: The new "moving" refusal has no test
findings.body: `relocate-copy.ts:35-36` adds a `moving` branch (`relocateMoving`), and the `explains each remaining refusal` table lists `recording` and `exporting` but not `moving`. Add `[{ ok: false, reason: "moving" }, /Wait for the move/]` so the new string and the switch case are covered. The `default` branch (`relocateFailed`) has no test either.

findings.title: The relocate row says "while a recording or export runs", but a group move now refuses it too
findings.body: `busyNow()` returns `"moving"` while a group move runs (`main/workspaces/index.ts:66-67`). It is wired into the relocate path through `activeTransactionDeps` (`index.ts:343-347`, spread at `index.ts:480`) and checked in `relocateRefusal` (`relocate.ts:24-25`). So `workspaces:relocate` is also refused while a move runs, and the new `relocateMoving` string says so. The spec row, and the matching sentence in `backlog/several-workspaces.md:26`, list only a recording or an export.

contracts.action: Change folder… (workspaces:relocate) is refused with the new reason "moving" while a group move runs
contracts.equivalent_path: Before this diff, `busy: busyNow` was in the relocate-only deps. Switch and relocate now both take it from `activeTransactionDeps()`.
contracts.before_after: Before: `switchWorkspace` and `relocateActive` read `deps.busy()` from `ActiveTransactionDeps` (`switch-transaction.ts:17,88-90,105`). After: `runSwitch` spreads `activeTransactionDeps()` (`index.ts:363`) and `relocateFolder` builds `{ ...activeTransactionDeps(), registry }` (`index.ts:480`), so both get the same `busyNow`, which includes "moving" (`index.ts:66-67`). `relocateRefusal` returns `{ok:false, reason: busy}` before the picker opens (`relocate.ts:24-25`), and `"moving"` is in `WorkspaceRelocateRefusal` (`shared/types/workspaces.ts:158`) and `RelocateOutcome` (`registry.ts:191`).
contracts.visible_effect: `relocateRefusalMessage` maps "moving" to `relocateMoving` (`relocate-copy.ts:35-36`). Both locale files have the key (`en.json:2630`, `es.json:2630`). The user sees "Wait for the move to finish…" instead of the generic `relocateFailed` fallback.
contracts.failure_mode: If a new reason were missing from the switch, the `default` branch shows `relocateFailed` rather than failing silently. `host?.busy() ?? (moveRun ? ...)` falls through correctly, because host `busy()` returns null when idle.

structuredOutput.summary: Part 1 is small and consistent. The new `moving` refusal reaches the relocate path. `busy: busyNow` now sits in the shared `activeTransactionDeps`. Both `runSwitch` and `relocateFolder` get it, `relocateRefusal` checks it before the picker opens, and the reason type, copy switch and en/es strings all match. I found no defects. There are two minor notes: the new `moving` case has no test, and the spec and backlog still list only a recording or an export as reasons relocate is refused. All earlier threads are marked addressed. For those, I took the owner's replies at face value, because the code they fixed is outside this part.
